name: Kinosei
source:
"It's just your imagination"

Kinosei, a BL/Yaoi Game that takes on a manga style and is devoid of any colour and it features the love of two boys from a band called Uppercutter Sharks.

[From [url=https://yustardino.itch.io/kinosei]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“这只是你的想象。”

《Kinosei》是一款BL游戏，采用漫画风格，全篇没有任何颜色，讲述乐队Uppercutter Sharks中两个男孩相爱的故事。

[来源：[url=https://yustardino.itch.io/kinosei]Itch.io[/url]]
